extends.note: Agent13 v1 already integrates Agent1's Raichu/Electrode delta. V2 adds uncovered rank2/rank5/rank9/rank19/rank30/rank31 families without changing the fixed 60.

status: actor-visible paper acceptance consolidation; no policy implementation, native game, competitive qualification, or win-rate claim

addedCases.state: AOR Vileplume is in play, Stoutland BCR is Active, candidate Items and Supporters are locked, Clefairy has two Energy, total Bench across both sides >=6.
addedCases.must: Choose/strongly value Full Moon Rondo as a clean 140-HP Stoutland KO and reopen Supporters.
addedCases.forbids: Treating simultaneous Item+Supporter lock as preventing attacks or requiring an Item/Supporter unlock first.

addedCases.state: Same dual lock, clean Stoutland, Clefairy has two Energy, total Bench <=5.
addedCases.must: Calculate Rondo below 140 and compare prior damage or another attacker.
addedCases.forbids: Hallucinating the six-Bench breakpoint.

addedCases.state: Irritating Pollen active; Powerglass in hand; legal Tool target; no separate Tool lock.
addedCases.must: Keep Powerglass legally playable because Pokémon Tools are not Items under current rules.
addedCases.forbids: Applying Item lock to Pokémon Tool cards.

addedCases.state: Bunnelby Active, AOR Vileplume live, Stoutland Benched, candidate can take Bunnelby KO.
addedCases.must: Score Stoutland promotion/Sentinel, then allow KO if continuation removes Stoutland without Item/Supporter help.
addedCases.forbids: Treating one-Prize KO as pure upside or hardcoding never-KO.

addedCases.state: Candidate goes second, Horror House legal, Grand Tree already in play.
addedCases.must: Compare replacing Grand Tree before Horror House; hand lock does not disable an in-play Stadium effect.
addedCases.forbids: Assuming Horror House switches off Grand Tree.

addedCases.state: Bunnelby Active under Horror House with enough Energy to retreat; Stoutland Benched.
addedCases.must: Expect ordinary retreat and Stoutland promotion during the locked turn.
addedCases.forbids: Treating Horror House as an Active-position lock.

addedCases.state: Dual lock active; direct Clefairy/Latias attack available; Pidgeot ex or Vileplume-GX support live; Path playable.
addedCases.must: Recognize Path can suppress Rule-Box support even though it does not suppress AOR Vileplume/Stoutland.
addedCases.forbids: Scoring Path only by whether it removes the two primary locks.

addedCases.state: Candidate goes first and has a pre-lock turn before rank2's going-second TM Evolution line; attacker/Powerglass/Basic-Psychic-discard setup competes with generic expansion.
addedCases.must: Prefer a credible in-lock attacker economy when it dominates low-impact setup.
addedCases.forbids: Burning the disappearing Item/setup window on access that becomes unusable under Vileplume.

addedCases.state: ADP already has a payable Double Dragon Energy and Horror House is legal.
addedCases.must: Do not credit Horror House with preventing Altered Creation-GX; the attack is already board-funded.
addedCases.forbids: Treating hand lock as attack lock.

addedCases.state: ADP lacks payable attached Energy and its next GX line depends on hand attachment/setup.
addedCases.must: Value Horror House denial of the missing hand-play channel.
addedCases.forbids: Ignoring the difference between funded and unfunded ADP.

addedCases.state: Altered Creation bonus is live and candidate is choosing an Active.
addedCases.must: Score TAG KO as 4 Prizes, two-Prize Rule Box as 3, one-Prize Active as 2.
addedCases.forbids: Using ordinary Prize values after Altered Creation.

addedCases.state: Fairy Zone live; candidate Clefairy has two Energy; total Bench >=5; Raging Bolt ex Active.
addedCases.must: Recognize Rondo reaches 120 then Psychic Weakness makes 240, a clean Bolt KO.
addedCases.forbids: Missing the five-Bench Dragon breakpoint.

addedCases.state: Fairy Zone live; candidate Clefairy has two Energy; total Bench >=6; ADP Active.
addedCases.must: Recognize Rondo reaches 140 then Psychic Weakness makes 280, a clean ADP KO.
addedCases.forbids: Missing the six-Bench Dragon breakpoint.

addedCases.state: Opposing Flutter Mane Active; candidate Clefairy Active.
addedCases.must: Suppress Fairy Zone and do not apply Psychic Weakness to the Dragon target.
addedCases.forbids: Keeping the Active Clefairy's Ability live through Flutter Mane.

addedCases.state: Opposing Flutter Mane Active; candidate Mewtwo Active.
addedCases.must: Suppress Perfection and route to a direct/non-Ability attack if available.
addedCases.forbids: Selecting copied attack solely because it is printed in Bench/discard.

addedCases.state: Fairy-Zone Dragon KO is available but Path would suppress Fairy Zone without New Moon protection.
addedCases.must: Compare and allow declining Path when its self-cost destroys the KO line.
addedCases.forbids: Treating Path access as automatic success.

addedCases.state: Sudowoodo Roadblock caps candidate Bench at four while Full Moon Rondo is being evaluated.
addedCases.must: Count actual Benched Pokémon on both sides; Roadblock does not cap source Bench contribution.
addedCases.forbids: Treating Roadblock as a fixed cap on Rondo damage.

addedCases.state: Solrock+Lunatone protect candidate and Path is active; Genesect draw is relevant.
addedCases.must: Suppress Fusion Strike System while preserving candidate via New Moon.
addedCases.forbids: Treating Path as symmetric in the protected state.

addedCases.state: Source Mew VMAX has DCE and a Benched Fusion Strike attack available under Path.
addedCases.must: Expect legal Cross Fusion Strike; Path disables Genesect Ability, not Mew's attack.
addedCases.forbids: Equating draw lock with attack lock.

addedCases.state: Mew VMAX used copied Techno Blast, has zero Retreat Cost, another attacker is Benched.
addedCases.must: Expect free retreat/promotion to remove the attack effect when legal.
addedCases.forbids: Treating Techno Blast's next-turn restriction as a guaranteed blank turn.

addedCases.state: Candidate Path+Horror House is live; source Stadium/Blower/Vacuum answers are only hand-played, not already active.
addedCases.must: Credit one protected hand-denial turn without claiming a permanent Stadium lock.
addedCases.forbids: Assuming source can play hand-based Stadium removal during Horror House or that it never can after.

addedCases.state: Full-HP 310 Mew VMAX is the target of repeated 150 Night Watch.
addedCases.must: Require at least 10 additional damage before crediting two Night Watch hits as a KO.
addedCases.forbids: Rounding 300 up to a 310-HP KO.

addedCases.state: Silent Lab active; candidate Basic Abilities and Stage-1 Electrode Bomb are relevant.
addedCases.must: Turn off candidate Basic Abilities while keeping Electrode-GX Extra Energy Bomb available.
addedCases.forbids: Generalizing Basic Ability lock to Stage-1 Electrode.

addedCases.state: Solrock+Lunatone already in play; source Silent Lab active; candidate Path playable.
addedCases.must: Recognize replacing Lab can reactivate New Moon before Path's Stadium effect is evaluated, making the Path line potentially asymmetric.
addedCases.forbids: Treating the old Lab suppression as persisting after replacement.

addedCases.state: Electrode live with eligible discard Energy and Mega Absol ex target.
addedCases.must: Allow Mega Absol as a Bomb recipient; lowercase modern ex is not the printed Pokémon-EX/GX exclusion.
addedCases.forbids: Rejecting Mega Absol because its name contains ex.

addedCases.state: Bomb already settled and Mega Absol is funded; candidate can now play Path.
addedCases.must: Do not credit later Path with removing already attached Energy; solve the funded attacker.
addedCases.forbids: Rewinding a resolved Ability.

addedCases.state: Slime Mold Colony live; candidate wants discard recovery.
addedCases.must: Block Trainer/Ability effects that put discard cards into hand, but preserve unrelated effects such as Powerglass attaching Energy from discard.
addedCases.forbids: Treating Toedscruel as a blanket discard-zone lock or ignoring it.

addedCases.state: Candidate is under source Horror House; Powerglass is already attached; board actions remain.
addedCases.must: Reject all hand plays, but preserve legal retreat/attacks/in-play Abilities and automatic attached-Powerglass end-turn effect.
addedCases.forbids: Treating Horror House as turn skip or suppressing an already-attached Tool's automatic effect.

addedCases.state: Source Clefairy is powered; candidate can add a low-impact Bench body.
addedCases.must: Add +20 to the source's strongest Full Moon Rondo reply before benching.
addedCases.forbids: Treating candidate Bench expansion as free setup value.

addedCases.state: Candidate Clefairy Active; nine total Benched Pokémon; source Clefairy can attack.
addedCases.must: Recognize opposing Rondo = 200 and KOs 190 HP Clefairy.
addedCases.forbids: Missing the nine-Bench mirror breakpoint.

addedCases.state: Source Mimikyu has Psychic+Colorless; candidate's previous attack was non-GX.
addedCases.must: Include Copycat using that attack without demanding its original Energy cost.
addedCases.forbids: Ignoring attack-copy retaliation.

addedCases.state: Candidate previous attack was Horror House-GX and source Mimikyu can Copycat.
addedCases.must: Reject Copycat of Horror House because its condition requires a non-GX attack.
addedCases.forbids: Allowing Copycat to copy a GX attack.

addedCases.state: Source Empoleon V is Active; candidate Basic no-Rule-Box Abilities and Rule-Box Basic Abilities are relevant.
addedCases.must: Suppress Lunatone New Moon/Unown/Klefki while leaving Mewtwo/Clefairy outside Emperor's Eyes itself.
addedCases.forbids: Treating Emperor's Eyes as all-Basic Ability lock.

addedCases.state: Empoleon Active, Solrock+Lunatone on candidate board, candidate Path option.
addedCases.must: Do not call Path asymmetric solely from board presence; Lunatone New Moon is currently suppressed by Empoleon.
addedCases.forbids: Ignoring the active suppression that disables the Stadium shield.

addedCases.state: Source Dusknoir self-KOs with Cursed Blast and candidate takes a Prize; Bloodmoon Ursaluna exists.
addedCases.must: Simultaneously reduce Blood Moon's cost by one in the source reply model.
addedCases.forbids: Scoring the self-KO Prize without its Ursaluna tempo benefit.

addedCases.state: Candidate 270-HP Mewtwo already has one Koffing damage counter; source can resolve two 130 Cursed Blasts.
addedCases.must: Recognize exact 270 effect KO; source gives 2 Prizes through self-KOs and takes 3 from TAG KO.
addedCases.forbids: Calling the two self-KOs automatically favorable to candidate.

addedCases.state: Source can self-KO Dusknoir then attack with cheaper Ursaluna; candidate can choose between one-Prize and multi-Prize Active lines.
addedCases.must: Compare Prize exchange, not HP alone; one-Prize Active can materially blunt the self-KO/Blood Moon conversion.
addedCases.forbids: Always promoting the highest-HP Rule Box.

addedCases.state: Roxie discards Koffing with multiple candidate Pokémon in play and BCR Dusknoir is live.
addedCases.must: Count one new counter on every candidate Pokémon and allow Sinister Hand to consolidate those counters.
addedCases.forbids: Treating Koffing spread as fixed total damage independent of board width.

addedCases.state: Bell of Silence active; TPE attachment/search legal; desired Basic Psychic has an Ability.
addedCases.must: Allow TPE to put that Pokémon directly from deck onto Bench; restriction is on playing such Pokémon from hand.
addedCases.forbids: Converting Bell of Silence into a universal Ability-Pokémon entry lock.

addedCases.state: Seasoned Skill currently discounts Blood Moon and candidate can play Path.
addedCases.must: Credit Path with removing Ursaluna's Rule-Box Ability while leaving non-Rule-Box Cursed Blast/Sinister Hand active.
addedCases.forbids: Calling Path a Dusknoir Ability lock.

addedCases.state: Grand Tree already in play before candidate Horror House.
addedCases.must: Do not credit hand lock with disabling the Stadium's in-play evolution effect; compare Stadium replacement first.
addedCases.forbids: Treating Horror House as Stadium-effect lock.

addedCases.state: Opposing Iron Thorns ex Initialization is active; candidate has Solrock + Lunatone in play; Path is playable; no separate effect suppresses Lunatone.
addedCases.must: Recognize Lunatone remains live because Initialization targets Rule-Box Abilities; candidate Path can be asymmetric, suppress opposing Initialization and restore Perfection.
addedCases.forbids: Treating Initialization as suppression of Lunatone or Path as automatically self-locking in this state.

addedCases.state: Candidate Klefki is Active with Mischievous Lock; Solrock + Lunatone and Mewtwo are in play; candidate wants an asymmetric Path/Perfection line.
addedCases.must: Treat Lunatone New Moon and Mewtwo Perfection as suppressed while Klefki stays Active; include switching/retreating Klefki before crediting the Path shield.
addedCases.forbids: Simultaneously treating active candidate Klefki lock and Lunatone New Moon as live.

addedCases.state: Prize state tied; candidate Dusclops uses Cursed Blast, self-KOs, and the selected opposing target survives.
addedCases.must: Update to candidate having one more Prize remaining than opponent and make Ace Trainer legal.
addedCases.forbids: Checking Ace Trainer from the pre-Blast Prize state.

addedCases.state: Prize state tied; candidate Dusclops Cursed Blast self-KOs and also KOs a one-Prize opposing Pokémon.
addedCases.must: Resolve both Prize events to parity and keep Ace Trainer illegal.
addedCases.forbids: Treating every candidate self-KO as Ace Trainer enablement.

addedCases.state: Prize state tied; candidate Dusclops Cursed Blast self-KOs and also KOs a two-Prize opposing Pokémon.
addedCases.must: Resolve candidate taking two while opponent takes one; candidate is ahead and Ace Trainer remains illegal.
addedCases.forbids: Ignoring opposing KO Prize value when evaluating the Supporter continuation.

addedCases.state: Source PRE Dusknoir self-KOs with Cursed Blast while Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex is a live continuation.
addedCases.must: Advance candidate Prize progress and reduce Blood Moon cost by one in the same transition.
addedCases.forbids: Scoring the gifted Prize without the Ursaluna discount.

addedCases.state: Altered Creation extra-Prize effect is live and a KO occurs.
addedCases.must: Apply the extra Prize only when the candidate Active is Knocked Out by attack damage from the boosted player's Pokémon.
addedCases.forbids: Adding one Prize to Ability/effect KOs, self-KOs, or non-Active KOs.

addedCases.state: Mewtwo & Mew-GX Perfection is suppressed; Mewtwo itself is able to attack, has Psychic/Psychic/Colorless, and GX is unused.
addedCases.must: Keep printed Miraculous Duo-GX as a legal 200-damage attack and score its optional extra-Energy heal if funded.
addedCases.forbids: Treating Perfection suppression as making Mewtwo attackless.

addedCases.state: BUS Vileplume Disgusting Pollen is active from the opponent's Active Spot.
addedCases.must: Reject attacks by every candidate Basic Pokémon while preserving Stage-1 Dusclops attack/Cursed Blast and legal lockbreak/gust lines.
addedCases.forbids: Confusing Ability access with permission for a Basic to attack.

addedCases.state: AOR Vileplume Irritating Pollen is active; candidate has a Pokémon Tool play such as Powerglass and no separate Tool restriction.
addedCases.must: Keep the Tool play legal under the current Advanced Rulebook distinction between Items and Pokémon Tools.
addedCases.forbids: Treating older/current Tools as Items for Vileplume's lock.

addedCases.state: AOR Vileplume Item lock and Active Stoutland Supporter lock are active; Galarian Articuno V is in play; Forest Seal Stone is in hand; VSTAR Power unused; no separate Tool lock.
addedCases.must: Keep Forest Seal Stone attachment and Star Alchemy legal as a Tool/VSTAR search channel through the dual lock.
addedCases.forbids: Treating Forest Seal Stone as an Item under the current rulebook.

addedCases.state: Same dual lock; Articuno V+FSS search is live; normal Energy attachment unused; TPE remains in deck; Clefairy is a legal TPE target.
addedCases.must: Permit Star Alchemy for TPE, attach TPE, then use its deck-to-Bench search to establish Clefairy, subject to Bench-liability target count.
addedCases.forbids: Calling the dual lock 'no search' when this Tool/Energy chain is available.

addedCases.state: Powerglass is attached/available for the intended Active, but candidate has no Basic Energy in discard.
addedCases.must: Do not credit the end-turn Powerglass attachment until a Basic Psychic actually reaches discard; plan custody if the line depends on it.
addedCases.forbids: Treating any discarded Energy or the Tool alone as sufficient.

addedCases.state: Powerglass is attached and the only Energy in discard is Telepathic Psychic Energy.
addedCases.must: Reject TPE as a Powerglass target because the Tool specifies Basic Energy.
addedCases.forbids: Treating TPE as Basic Psychic just because it provides Psychic Energy.

addedCases.state: Candidate has a nonessential Benched Unown with Farewell Letter live; opponent has an established Bench-punishment axis (spread, Rondo, movable-counter production or Block+gust).
addedCases.must: Compare Farewell Letter before passing, including Prize-packet, Rondo, counter-mass and trap reduction.
addedCases.forbids: Leaving the 60-HP body solely because it was previously useful setup.

addedCases.state: Candidate wants to cash out Benched Unown but a live Basic/global Ability suppressor removes Farewell Letter.
addedCases.must: Do not use Farewell Letter; solve or wait out the suppression if the cash-out remains valuable.
addedCases.forbids: Treating the Ability as always available on the Bench.

addedCases.state: Opponent has a 14-packet Electro Rain/Sight frontier; candidate Bench includes Gengar & Mimikyu-GX, Tapu Lele-GX and 60-HP Duskull; Duskull can legally evolve to 90-HP Dusclops before the reply.
addedCases.must: Recognize evolution changes the three-target six-Prize packet requirement from 7+5+2=14 to 7+5+3=15 and can deny that exact one-Bomb line.
addedCases.forbids: Treating evolution as irrelevant because Prize value is unchanged.

addedCases.state: Nonessential Unown remains Benched; Farewell Letter live; opponent has Block plus credible gust capacity.
addedCases.must: Value proactive Farewell Letter before Unown can be gusted Active, where its Ability would no longer be usable.
addedCases.forbids: Waiting until the trap is already active to attempt a Bench-only Ability.

addedCases.state: Candidate Latias ex is under its prior Eon Blade 'can't attack' effect; Skyliner is live; a second attacker is Benched; normal retreat is legal.
addedCases.must: Permit zero-cost retreat to Bench, remove the attack effect, and continue with the promoted attacker.
addedCases.forbids: Treating Eon Blade as a whole-turn attack lock on the candidate.

addedCases.state: Opponent Defending Pokémon carries Pale Moon-GX delayed-KO effect but has a legal actor-visible retreat/switch/evolution route before turn end.
addedCases.must: Price that mobility and do not score the delayed KO as guaranteed.
addedCases.forbids: Treating Pale Moon text as unconditional once declared.

addedCases.state: Opponent Defending Pokémon carries Pale Moon-GX delayed-KO effect and has no actor-visible legal route to leave Active before turn end.
addedCases.must: Credit the delayed KO unless a prior game-ending event intervenes.
addedCases.forbids: Discounting Pale Moon solely because switching is theoretically possible in other states.

addedCases.state: K1 shows Galarian Articuno V Prized; Forest Seal Stone remains accessible. Hisuian Heavy Ball and current Item legality may or may not provide Prize recovery.
addedCases.must: If HHB is accessible and Item play is legal, keep Articuno/FSS continuation recoverable through HHB; if Item play is locked/unavailable, treat FSS as temporarily hostless and re-evaluate DCI.
addedCases.forbids: Equating a Prized Basic host with permanent inaccessibility or ignoring Item lock on the recovery route.

addedCases.state: K1 shows exactly one of Solrock or Lunatone Prized; Hisuian Heavy Ball and Item legality are known.
addedCases.must: Permit HHB recovery of the Prized Basic partner when legal; otherwise treat the asymmetric-Path pair as temporarily broken.
addedCases.forbids: Crediting the pair from one member alone or deleting it despite an available HHB recovery.

addedCases.state: K1 shows singleton Gengar & Mimikyu-GX Prized; HHB recovery access and Item legality are known.
addedCases.must: Permit Hisuian Heavy Ball to recover the Prized Basic Gengar when legal; otherwise remove Horror House/Poltergeist donor continuations until recovery.
addedCases.forbids: Treating Prized Gengar as permanently inaccessible or pretending HHB works through Item lock.

addedCases.state: K1 shows both Duskull copies Prized; Dusclops remains outside Prizes; HHB recovery access and Item legality are known.
addedCases.must: Permit HHB to exchange for one Prized Basic Duskull when legal, restoring the evolution chain; under Item lock/unavailability treat the chain as temporarily blocked.
addedCases.forbids: Calling Dusclops permanently stranded despite legal Basic-Pokémon Prize recovery.

addedCases.state: Perfection is suppressed and native Gengar & Mimikyu-GX is the selected attack/lock continuation; a discard-paying action can use Gengar as payment.
addedCases.must: Protect native Gengar unless explicitly abandoning that continuation for a stronger line.
addedCases.forbids: Treating donor-in-discard value as dominant while the native attacker is the actual recovery channel.

addedCases.state: Current attack is already funded; Powerglass is the selected future Energy engine; a Basic Psychic can be discarded without breaking another prerequisite.
addedCases.must: Allow the Basic Psychic as productive discard because it seeds a legal Powerglass target.
addedCases.forbids: Applying a permanent 'never discard Energy' rule.

addedCases.state: Powerglass continuation needs Basic Psychic and only one accessible Basic Psychic remains; a discard/search cost competes for it.
addedCases.must: Protect the last Basic Psychic unless the action explicitly changes to a stronger continuation.
addedCases.forbids: Treating TPE in discard as an equivalent Powerglass target.

addedCases.state: Secret Box is mechanically playable or being evaluated, but one or more fetched categories are currently unusable because AOR Vileplume Item lock or Stoutland Supporter lock is active.
addedCases.must: Do not count a currently unplayable fetched category as immediate bundle value; compare the whole Box line against legal non-Box continuations.
addedCases.forbids: Rewarding theoretical four-category connectivity when the lock removes one or more categories.

addedCases.state: Reconstitute is available but its only two discard candidates are protected continuation resources and the draw is not guaranteed to repair the line.
addedCases.must: Reject discard-2/draw-1 smoothing unless intentionally abandoning the continuation.
addedCases.forbids: Treating Reconstitute as generic positive draw regardless of payment.

addedCases.state: Ace Trainer is legal after settled Prize transitions; Night Watch is payable after the Supporter; no immediate win dominates.
addedCases.must: Credit Ace reducing opponent to 3 followed by Night Watch shuffling 2 random cards as a distinct one-card-hand control line.
addedCases.forbids: Scoring Ace only as candidate draw six.

addedCases.state: Candidate has exactly six Prize cards remaining and Lillie's Determination is legal.
addedCases.must: Use the draw-8 mode in the continuation comparison and remove that mode after candidate takes a Prize.
addedCases.forbids: Treating Lillie's Determination as fixed draw six in all states.

addedCases.state: A draw Supporter is legal but the current hand already contains a deterministic winning continuation.
addedCases.must: Preserve the winning hand and execute the line unless the Supporter creates an even higher-priority win/survival result.
addedCases.forbids: Playing a shuffle-draw Supporter solely for nominal card count.

addedCases.state: Candidate has a meaningful Supporter action now and actor-visible board development makes Active Stoutland Sentinel likely on the opponent's next turn.
addedCases.must: Price the current turn as a disappearing Supporter window before passing or spending the turn on lower-value actions.
addedCases.forbids: Assuming the Supporter can simply be played next turn after Stoutland promotes.

addedCases.state: Candidate has already played a Supporter this turn and Secret Box is being evaluated.
addedCases.must: Treat the Box Supporter category as unplayable this turn and value only categories/continuations that remain live.
addedCases.forbids: Counting a fetched Supporter as same-turn value after the Supporter quota is spent.

addedCases.state: After setup/mulligan bonus resolution candidate has only one Basic in play, but the first normal turn has a legal Battle VIP Pass, Fog Crystal, TPE, Mysterious Treasure or directly drawn second Basic route.
addedCases.must: Spend sufficient setup resources to establish at least one Benched survivor before passing.
addedCases.forbids: Preserving ordinary setup efficiency while leaving an immediate no-Pokémon loss exposure.

addedCases.state: Klefki is the candidate's only Basic at initial setup; no second Basic is yet available.
addedCases.must: Use Klefki as the required Active and prioritize creating a Benched survivor on the first normal turn; do not treat Mischievous Lock alone as immunity to a donk.
addedCases.forbids: Assuming a lone Klefki makes the no-Pokémon loss condition irrelevant.

addedCases.state: Perfection is live and candidate has modern lowercase ex or Pokémon V bodies such as Clefairy ex, Latias ex, Squawkabilly ex or Articuno V on Bench/discard.
addedCases.must: Do not expose those attacks through Perfection; only Pokémon-GX/Pokémon-EX are eligible donors.
addedCases.forbids: Normalizing Perfection donor class to Rule Box or any ex/V.

addedCases.state: Tapu Lele-GX is a legal Perfection donor; Mewtwo has two Colorless-equivalent Energy; Energy Drive is a candidate attack.
addedCases.must: Calculate 20 times the total Energy attached to both Active Pokémon and do not apply Weakness/Resistance.
addedCases.forbids: Omitting the two-Energy donor attack or doubling it with Fairy Zone.

addedCases.state: Tapu Lele-GX is a legal donor, GX unused, Mewtwo can pay Psychic, and healing two damaged Benched Pokémon has survival value.
addedCases.must: Keep Tapu Cure-GX as a legal copied GX option and compare against other GX uses.
addedCases.forbids: Deleting nondamaging donor GX attacks from the action set.

addedCases.state: TPE searches Tapu Lele-GX from deck and puts it directly onto the Bench.
addedCases.must: Do not trigger Wonder Tag because Lele was not played from hand.
addedCases.forbids: Treating all Bench-entry routes as hand play.

addedCases.state: Tapu Lele-GX is legally played from candidate hand onto the Bench and Wonder Tag is not suppressed.
addedCases.must: Permit Wonder Tag to search a Supporter, subject to later Supporter-play legality.
addedCases.forbids: Losing the beneficial play-from-hand trigger because another route to Lele also exists.

addedCases.state: Bell of Silence restriction is active; TPE can legally put Tapu Lele-GX from deck onto Bench.
addedCases.must: Permit the direct TPE deployment but do not trigger Wonder Tag; reject playing Lele from hand while the restriction applies.
addedCases.forbids: Either turning Bell into universal Bench-entry denial or inventing Wonder Tag on direct deployment.

addedCases.state: Poltergeist is legal but target remaining HP exceeds 50 times the public opponent hand size and no damage modifier changes that ceiling.
addedCases.must: Reject Poltergeist as an immediate KO line regardless of hidden hand composition.
addedCases.forbids: Using hidden Trainer count or treating hand size as unlimited damage.

addedCases.state: GX unused; extra-Psychic Horror House is legal; candidate survives the strongest actor-visible board-only reply; opponent hand is below seven; next-turn Poltergeist is selected.
addedCases.must: Credit the draw-to-seven plus hand-play lock as a large-hand setup while keeping Trainer identities uncertain and updating any board-only hand modifiers.
addedCases.forbids: Treating the large hand as a guaranteed Trainer count or ignoring the opponent's legal board-only reply.

addedCases.state: Candidate selects Ace Trainer followed by Night Watch; future Poltergeist is also being evaluated.
addedCases.must: Reduce future Poltergeist ceiling according to the compressed opponent hand rather than simultaneously crediting large-hand Poltergeist value.
addedCases.forbids: Scoring opposite hand-size objectives as if both happen.

addedCases.state: A legal reveal effect established one or more Trainer identities that are known to remain in the opponent's current hand.
addedCases.must: Maintain only persistent known Trainers as a deterministic Poltergeist lower bound; clear identities when hand-reset/movement destroys continuity.
addedCases.forbids: Promoting old revealed cards to permanent hand knowledge.

addedCases.state: Opponent is under Horror House but has a legal already-in-play effect that changes its hand.
addedCases.must: Resolve the board-only hand change and update public hand size before evaluating next-turn Poltergeist.
addedCases.forbids: Freezing the hand size solely because cards cannot be played from hand.

addedCases.state: Iron Thorns Initialization active; candidate TPE can put Solrock+Lunatone onto Bench; Path is available; no separate Basic Ability suppressor is active.
addedCases.must: Recognize both pair Abilities remain live under Initialization and Path can then suppress opposing Initialization while candidate ignores the Stadium.
addedCases.forbids: Treating Initialization as suppression of Solrock/Lunatone.

addedCases.state: Fresh native Gengar has one Psychic, Powerglass attached, Basic Psychic in discard, GX unused and Horror House legal.
addedCases.must: After Horror House, resolve Powerglass end-turn attachment of the Basic Psychic to Gengar, leaving Poltergeist funded for the next candidate turn.
addedCases.forbids: Waiting for the next normal attachment or trying to attach TPE through Powerglass.

crossFamilyPolicyInvariants: Bench width must be scored as an opponent resource, not only candidate setup: Electro Rain Prize packets, Full Moon Rondo damage, Koffing counter production and Snorlax trap surface all increase with unnecessary bodies.
Horror House denies cards played from hand, not attacks, retreat, already-in-play Stadium effects, or in-play Abilities.
Path to the Peak has matchup-specific jobs and can be dominated by its self-suppression cost unless New Moon is actually active.
Native/direct attackers must remain available when Basic Ability suppression turns off Perfection.
Resolved effects are not rewound: post-Bomb Path does not remove attached Energy; post-Altered-Creation New Moon has no Ranger reset in the fixed 60.
Discrete HP/Prize breakpoints override average-damage heuristics.

Ability suppression is scoped, not binary: recompute Basic/Rule-Box/Active/global suppression before and after Stadium replacement; Iron Thorns leaves Lunatone live, while Klefki/Silent Lab/Empoleon can disable the New Moon shield.

Prize state is a transition variable, not a score: settle simultaneous self-KO/effect-KO Prize events before recomputing Ace Trainer, Reversal/Counter Energy, Ursaluna discounts and Altered-Creation Prize modifiers.

A lock deletes only its actual action class: Ability suppression, Basic attack suppression, Item lock, Supporter lock and hand-play lock require different fallback sets; recompute native printed attacks before declaring lockout.

Lock-resilient search is multi-channel: TPE Energy, Forest Seal Stone Tool/VSTAR search, Powerglass Basic-Energy recursion and Stadium replacement survive different card-type locks; track Tool and Basic-Energy custody explicitly.
Before passing into Bench-punishment, compress/harden existing liabilities: Farewell unneeded Unown when legal and evolve Duskull when the HP/Stage change alters opponent reply thresholds.

Attack effects persist only while their target remains in the relevant state: explicitly score retreat/switch/evolution before treating copied Techno Blast, Eon Blade or Pale Moon as future-turn guarantees.

Discard-paying connectors are continuation transactions, not raw access: select the line first, classify payments dynamically, then compare the whole post-payment continuation against not using the connector.

Supporter value is continuation-specific: settle Prize legality first, preserve deterministic hands, exploit disappearing Supporter windows, and score Ace Trainer's opponent reset together with Night Watch rather than as draw volume.

New Moon has 17 Basics (not 19 Pokémon-as-Basics); rank26 setup policy must distinguish lone-Active exposure from actual donk exposure and spend first-turn Bench access aggressively before returning to ordinary Bench-liability minimization.

Connector routes preserve exact movement semantics: destination alone does not determine triggers; TPE direct deployment can bypass hand-play locks while forfeiting Wonder Tag, and Perfection donors are exact Pokémon-GX/EX rather than generic Rule Box bodies.

Opponent hand size is dual-use: compression improves denial but reduces Poltergeist ceiling; extra-Psychic Horror can enlarge/freeze the hand for Poltergeist, but hidden Trainer identities remain uncertain.

Against exact Iron Thorns lists, TPE->Solrock/Lunatone->Path plus native Horror House can create a protected lock turn, and Powerglass can attach the second Basic Psychic after the attack; survival still depends on full-HP Gengar and actor-visible board attack damage.

At K1, exact Prize knowledge must recompute continuation viability **with recovery access**: Prized Basics may be recoverable through Hisuian Heavy Ball while Items are legal, whereas Prized Stage 1/Trainer prerequisites are not HHB targets.

required: Pass every inherited and added actor-visible case or produce an explicit, reviewable alternative continuation for any case the policy intentionally rejects.
Expose selected continuation, strongest immediate opponent reply, Prize delta, Bench delta, and any card protected from discard/search cost.
TPE target selection must permit 0, 1, or 2 legal targets.
Attack-copy, self-KO, Stadium replacement, Active/Bench Ability scope, and hand-lock semantics must be represented from actor-visible state.
No hidden opponent hand identities, face-down Prize identities, or future draws may be used.
implementationGate.stopCondition: Failure on a family gate is evidence against policy readiness and can trigger architecture reconsideration before native/full-game compute; it is not permission to silently add cards to the fixed 60.
